title: Optimization: GraphQL query batching opportunities
body:
Future optimization: batch multiple GraphQL reads into single queries.

- Editor load: batch get_branch_sha + get_file into a single query
- Dashboard sort-by-date: batch directory listing + per-file last-commit-date into one query using history(first: 1) on each tree entry
- Branch selector + CI status: batch branch list + check suite status per branch
